package.description: Virtual Community of Education and Character Progression

en-US.description: Virtual Community of Education and Character Progression
en-US.longDescription: Mole is a safe, healthy and educational virtual interactive community designed specifically for Chinese children aged from 6 to 14, in which each child takes on the adorable character Mole and becomes the owner of this virtual world. The community integrates virtual character customization, virtual houses, interactive games, and nurturing activities, providing children with a comprehensive interactive entertainment platform.
en-US.name: 摩尔庄园

zh-CN.description: 益智养成互动虚拟社区
zh-CN.longDescription: 摩尔庄园是专为中国 6－14 岁儿童设计的安全健康益智的虚拟互动社区，每个儿童化身可爱的小鼹鼠摩尔，成为这个虚拟世界的主人，社区融合虚拟形象装扮、虚拟小屋、互动游戏、爱心养成为一体，为儿童提供综合互动娱乐平台。
zh-CN.name: 摩尔庄园
